Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Where and how you can work

Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. But you have choice in where and how you work. That means if you want to do your thing in the office (if you're near one), at home or a bit of both, it's up to you.

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

• A highly Collaborative Approach. You're happiest when working closely with other Designers, Engineers and Product Managers. You value feedback and brainstorming ideas.

They are also enablers, in building and maintaining the foundational AI/ML systems needed for help and support use cases.

But that's not all - the AI Experience team is also a team of stewards, responsible for the governance and ownership of data across the Supergroup. With a friendly, kind, and approachable style, this team is committed to inclusivity and making sure that everyone's needs are met. If you're keen to join a team that is dedicated to using AI to make the world a better place, this is the team for you.

But don't just take our word for it, check out what Design Lead - Chen Zhang has to say about working in Design at Canva -

"I love working at Canva because I really am empowering the world to design by designing"

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

job_description:
We are seeking a skilled AI developer to embark on an innovative project aimed at revolutionizing customer service monitoring in the restaurant industry. Our vision is to develop a cutting-edge video analytics AI capable of real-time analysis from one to three camera feeds in a restaurant setting. This AI will be tasked with the unique challenge of processing images from these cameras to track and analyze the interactions between restaurant managers and patrons.

The core functionality of this AI includes identifying restaurant managers as they engage with guests, quantifying these engagements by monitoring visits to tables for a minimum duration of five seconds, and distinguishing which tables have been approached. Additionally, the system must log the duration of each interaction, the specific times they occur, and identify which manager was involved. This data will be crucial in enhancing the quality of customer service and managerial effectiveness.

This project will initially be implemented in one restaurant for testing, with the potential to expand to approximately 20 more locations. Compensation will be project-based per restaurant, with an opportunity for a monthly retainer as technical support following successful implementation and testing. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in not only developing but also potentially maintaining the system, ensuring its smooth operation. Initially, the AI will be deployed on a desktop PC, with plans to migrate the system to Azure within 8-9 months. We are looking for a dedicated individual who is not just technically proficient but also a good team player willing to contribute to the success of this venture.
